$comment: Licences allowed for Herald's .NET and web packages, direct and transitive (CLAUDE.md, ADR 0009; harness-engineering D-5). A package outside this list fails scripts/rules.mjs until the maintainer decides. Accepted 12 November 2026 as the licences in use then.

allowed.MPL-2.0: File-level copyleft: Herald does not modify these files; accepted by the maintainer.
allowed.CC-BY-4.0: Data, not code (browser compatibility data); accepted by the maintainer.
allowed.Python-2.0: Permissive in practice for the bundled helper using it; accepted by the maintainer.
allowed.Unlicense: Public domain dedication (tweetnacl, in the end-to-end suite). Proposed in harness-engineering; the maintainer confirms it in review.
allowed.WTFPL: Permissive (a cspell dictionary, development only). Proposed in harness-engineering; the maintainer confirms it in review.
allowed.CC BY-SA 4.0: Share-alike data (cspell's common-misspellings list, development only, not distributed). Proposed in harness-engineering; the maintainer confirms it in review.

Fractions.reason: Declared as a licence file; read on 12 November 2026.

System.Security.Cryptography.ProtectedDa.reason: Declares the .NET corefx licence URL, which is MIT.
